how.title: Indlela yokulanda
how.step1.title: Kopisha ilinki
how.step1.text: Vula okuthunyelwe ku-app, thepha Yabelana, bese ukhetha Kopisha ilinki.
how.step2.title: Yinamathisele lapha
how.step2.text: Namathisela ilinki ebhokisini elingenhla, bese ucindezela Landa.
how.step3.title: Khetha futhi ulondoloze
how.step3.text: Khetha ividiyo, umsindo we-MP3, noma isithombe ngekhwalithi oyifunayo.
platforms.title: Izinkundla ezisekelwayo
platforms.lead: Amavidiyo, izithombe nomsindo kusuka emakhulwini amasayithi. Amanye adume kakhulu:
faq.title: Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa
faq.a1: Yebo, imahhala ngokuphelele. Akudingeki ukubhalisa, ukungena ngemvume, noma i-app.
faq.a2: Ku-Android nakumakhompyutha, amafayela aya kufolda ethi Okulandiwe. Ku-iPhone naku-iPad (Safari), alondolozwa ku-app ethi Amafayela → Okulandiwe. Ukusuka lapho ungawalondoloza ku-Izithombe ngenkinobho ethi Yabelana.
faq.a3: Iseva yethu ayikwazi ukufinyelela okuqukethwe okuyimfihlo, okudinga ukungena ngemvume, noma okukhawulelwe ngokwesifunda. Qiniseka ukuthi okuthunyelwe kusesidlangalaleni, bese uzama futhi.
faq.a4: Ngemuva kokuthi ilinki icutshunguliwe, khetha inketho ethi MP3 ngaphansi kokuthi Umsindo. Umsindo uthathwa evidiyweni bese uguqulelwa ku-MP3 ye-192 kbps.
faq.a5: Sihlala sincamela inguqulo engenalo uphawu lwamanzi uma itholakala. Izinketho ezinophawu lwamanzi zibhalwe ukuthi Uphawu lwamanzi.
faq.q6: Ingabe amafayela ami agcinwa kuseva yenu?
faq.a6: Cha. Amafayela athunyelwa ngqo esuka enkundleni yokuqala aye kudivayisi yakho, futhi awagcinwa kuseva yethu.

toast.failed: Ukulanda kuhlulekile. Zama enye ikhwalithi noma ucubungule ilinki futhi.
